name: Call of Water

angles.text: This trial is a crucial step in communing with the elements to earn the water totem rites and craft the sapta needed to see elemental spirits.
The journey connects dwarven shamanic candidates with elemental mentors like Norric Lochthane across Khaz Modan.
Alliance shamans seek communion with water spirits across eastern lands, bridging Loch Modan and Westfall.

faq.answer: Norric Lochthane is a mentor residing in Loch Modan who guides candidates through their elemental communion. He oversees the preparations and rites needed to earn the water totem.

Hervdana Saegrund is the guide in the Wetlands, living with her family in a cave by the southern falls, who blesses sacred water gathered by aspiring shamans, imbuing it with the spiritual purity required to craft water sapta.
A sapta is an elemental draught prepared using sacred water. Drinking it allows a shaman to pierce the veil and perceive elusive water spirits that dwell within natural pools.
faq.q: What is a sapta used for?

faq.answer: Stendel's Pond is located in Westfall near Moonbrook. Its waters harbor elemental water spirits that a shaman must seek out after consuming their prepared sapta.

The Vial of Purest Water contains blessed water essential for brewing the water sapta and performing the sacred rites required to earn a water totem. Norric cautions that not even a single drop may be wasted.
faq.q: Why is the Vial of Purest Water important?

faq.answer: The water totem rites are spiritual trials undertaken by shamans to attune themselves to the element of water, demonstrating respect and balance before being granted a water totem.
faq.q: What are the water totem rites?

sections.body: The Call of Water represents an essential trial of spiritual attunement for aspiring shamans seeking harmony with the element of water. Undertaking this path requires gathering water blessed by Hervdana herself, proving both patience and reverence for the spirits before bringing the vessel to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
sections.title: The Path to the Water Totem

sections.body: Upon receiving the blessed vessel, Norric reveals that the sacred liquid is destined to brew a water sapta. This draught allows the seeker to pierce the unseen and witness the water spirits dwelling at Stendel's Pond near Moonbrook. Every single drop is deemed precious, as even a dampened stopper holds purpose in the sacred rites.
sections.title: Birthing the Sapta

summary: The Call of Water is a spiritual trial for shamans seeking the sacred water totem rites. By delivering pure water blessed by Hervdana to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, seekers prepare the elemental sapta necessary to commune with spirits at Stendel's Pond.
